item.title:
DUSTCUBE &
DUSTCUBE MAX
item.dc:creator: aaron
item.content:encoded:
DUSTCUBE &
DUSTCUBE MAX

From Dust Abatement to Event Parking

Product Summary

Get better air quality and save water with DustCube from TechniSoil.

DustCube is 250 gallons of ready to-use, environmentally safe, liquid polymer emulsion that provides seasonal dust control by adhering small dust particles to larger particles, preventing them from becoming an airborne irritant.

DustCube treats up to a 5000 sf of Dirt-Base rock-Decomposed Granite

DustCube is designed to offer dust abatement to not trafficked surfaces such as;

Unused dirt lots- Undeveloped construction sites- Fields and Farms

DustCube MAX is a cost-effective soil and crushed stone stabilizer for large-scale surfaces

DustCube MAX offers dust control, but also surface solidification, creating a hard surface

DustCube MAX works best with a structural ‘road base’, but also with crushed stone mixes, soil and in-situ material in certain applications

DustCube MAX is perfect for; Temporary event parking, RV storage yards, Secondary driving and parking, Public Park trails, Education and Business commons

*As with all of our products, DustCube is ECO-Friendly

Specifications

item.title: MOLECULE™ SRS
item.dc:creator: aaron
item.content:encoded:
Molecule™ SRS

MOLECULE STAIN RESISTANT SEALER TECHNOLOGY

OIL-WATER-CHEMICAL STAIN RESISTANT

Driveways- Outdoor Dining - Entertainment- Public Parks

Product Summary

Molecule sealer products represent next-generation, STAIN RESISTANT technology.

Molecule offers premium hardscape protection from water, oil and chemical stains

Molecule is a penetrates the surface to provide robust ‘water-beading’, while being 100% breathable.

Molecule keeps the ‘bad stains’ off the surface, without trapping sub-surface staining. 

Molecule products are VOC-free, ready-to-use out of the bottle, and easy to apply.

PREMIUM STAIN PROTECTION- ALLEVIATE TIRE-TRACKING- REDUCE MAINTENANCE 

Molecule[SRS] Stain Resistant Sealer is specifically designed for hardscape and vertical surface sealing

Molecule SRS is perfect for driveways, restaurant patios, pool decks, entertainment areas and any heavy-use surface. 

Molecule SRS can be used on; Concrete Pavers, Brick, Natural Stone, Tile, Poured Concrete

Molecule SRS also works on vertical masonry to reduce water staining and dirt on surfaces such as; decorative concrete, brick, natural and artificial stone, stucco and CMU.

Molecule SRS reduces staining from vehicle tires, debris, and most liquids while limiting freeze-thaw damage in cold weather climates and prevents color fading from UV.

KEEP YOUR MULCH IN PLACE!

Reduces WIND and WATER Erosion

ENVIRONMENTALLY SAFE- REDUCE MAINTENANCE

BarkBinder topically applied liquid stabilizer acts like ‘hairspray’ for shredded bark, mulch ground cover, pine straw, and more.

BarkBinder also works as a sealant to protect and retain the ‘color’ of your bark/mulch
